sloka: लन्का आभरणम् इति एव सो अमन्यत महा कपिः ।चचार हनुमाम्स्तत्र रावणस्य समीपतः ॥५-६-१५॥
transliteration: lankā ābharaṇam iti eva so amanyata mahā kapiḥ ।cacāra hanumāmstatra rāvaṇasya samīpataḥ ॥5-6-15॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the great monkey, saw the royal mansion looking brilliant with elephants, horses and chariots. He thought that the palace was the very ornament of Lanka. He moved unnoticed into the close quarters of Ravana.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने उस राजभवन को लंकापुरी का भूषण समझा। वे अब उस स्थान पर गये, जहाँ रावण सी रहा था
